svg.aria-label: Architecture figure: GitHub feeds a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline (checkout, unit test, build, SonarQube scan, Docker build, push image) which pushes to Docker Hub and helm-deploys to an AKS cluster running the Flask microservice and a Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager observability stack behind an Azure load balancer; Terraform-provisioned Azure infrastructure, Helm's deployment strategy, and the pipeline's stored credentials sit below the cluster; a flow-summary strip at the bottom recaps push-to-monitor in six steps.
svg.text: 1) FLASK MICROSERVICE ON AZURE KUBERNETES SERVICE (AKS)
END-TO-END CI/CD WITH JENKINS, TERRAFORM, ANSIBLE & PROMETHEUS/GRAFANA
West US 2 · SSH-key auth · NSG restricts inbound · provisioned by Terraform
